name: Muhammad Ishaq Khan
tagline: I ship the products I own: ProxiCall, a live Flutter super-app, and backbencher.cc, an AST-native code intelligence platform.
about: I'm a software engineer based in Budapest and a Computer Science graduate of Eötvös Loránd University (ELTE). Right now I'm building ProxiCall — a production Flutter proximity super-app with Stripe Connect payments, geo-fencing, and 38-language content translation.

Alongside it I develop backbencher.cc, an AST-native code intelligence platform that indexes codebases into a queryable knowledge graph with 20+ brain tools. I've contributed to VS Code (performance) and Flutter (security hardening), and my BSc thesis on OSINT-enhanced phishing detection reached 96.45% accuracy.

projects.name: backbencher.cc (bb)
projects.description: My primary project — an open-core AST-native code intelligence platform that indexes entire codebases into a local SQLite knowledge graph. Ships with 20+ brain tools for semantic search, call-graph traversal, AST-precise refactoring, architectural pattern detection, cross-language migration, and security scanning across 35+ languages.
highlights: 20+ brain tools — bb_search, bb_select, bb_refactor, bb_relationships, bb_security, bb_migrate, bb_patterns, bb_visualize, bb_impact, bb_health, bb_trace, bb_explain and more
35+ languages parsed by Tree-sitter grammars
Offline semantic search with word vectors
Beats Copilot on compiler-level code reasoning — benchmarked against TypeScript (VS Code) and Roslyn codebases

projects.name: ProxiCall
projects.description: Production Flutter proximity super-app — location-based content delivery, Stripe Connect payment management, order management, 38-language content translation, and geo-targeted notifications with AI segmentation.
highlights: 5 integrated systems (CMS, PMS, OMS, NMS, ENS)
Instant storefronts — 9 themes, generated and published for every registered business
38 languages for content translation, one canonical code set shared by the app and the web micro-sites
Geo-fenced notifications with AI segmentation
Multi-currency money layer on Stripe Connect — onboarding, refunds, disputes and dispute recovery
Append-only wallet ledger with a hash chain, probed by 13 SQL integrity and tamper harnesses
262 SQL migrations and row-level-security completeness checks behind the data layer
Paid Azure and DeepL translation metered per business through one gate, so a Free tier can't drain characters

projects.name: PhishGuard
projects.description: BSc Thesis — phishing detection system combining XGBoost ML (96.45% accuracy), NLP with 10 tactic detectors, and OSINT enrichment (WHOIS, DNS, VirusTotal).

725 automated tests (592 pytest + 133 Jest)
Full-featured UI with dark/light theme

projects.name: tree-sitter-clean
projects.description: Clean grammar for tree-sitter — enables code intelligence, syntax highlighting, and AST parsing for the Clean programming language. Published to both npm and PyPI.
highlights: Enables Clean language support in the Tree-sitter ecosystem
Available on npm and PyPI (v1.2.5)

projects.name: Histofy v2
projects.description: Manifest V3 Chrome extension that turns the GitHub contribution graph into an editor: click any date tile to set a contribution level, then deploy the pattern as real commits through the GitHub API. Nine content scripts inject into github.com, state persists per user and repository, and the graph is navigable across years.
highlights: Manifest V3: a background service worker plus 9 content scripts injected on github.com
Contribution-level model validated against GitHub's own intensity thresholds
Per-user, per-repository selection state persisted in extension storage
Deploys real commits through the GitHub API, creating or reusing a repository

projects.name: This portfolio
projects.description: The site you are reading. Every project, skill, timeline entry, contribution and book comes from a single config file, so a fork needs that file and no component edits. Live GitHub and npm stats, a social card and a résumé PDF all generated from the same config at build time.

experience.description: Running the platform end to end — parsing pipeline, storage, CLI/MCP surface and releases — and turning it outward: five patches merged upstream — four my own PRs, plus a VS Code chat memory leak whose fix credits my report by name — and a Tree-sitter grammar published to npm and PyPI.
Own the money and location layers behind a live consumer app: Stripe Connect onboarding and payouts, geo-fenced delivery, and the notification pipeline the growth team campaigns through.
